## Resolved by grammar (the points the brief named)
- The Queen's speech (units 9-10): concessive እንዘ ... ኮንኩ + accusative predicate is right; ዓብድ = ዕብድ 'fool' (spelling variant); ኢያመልክ is 3ms in form and now marked [3ms; sic] in `l` as in ch. 28, rendered as her vow; ዘትቤ is 'what you said' (ይቤ's prefix forms are its perfect), not 'you say'.
- ምንንት: only 'despised / estranged' is available from መነነ (cf. ch. 13-16 መነነ 'renounced'); kept with (?). The እምአምላከ እስራኤል phrase could attach to it or to ኅሪት; noted, sense of the contrast unaffected.
- ደባትር: 'tents' kept (cf. ደብተራ in ch. 17-19), with the note that the plural suits ደብተር 'scroll, book' equally; still (?).
- The closing conditional (unit 20): ነኣስ is masculine, so it cannot describe the Queen (she uses feminine ኅሪት); ተስሕተ takes the accusative ('stray from'); the apodosis is a plain consequence, not a curse. Still (?), as the logic of the speech is not recoverable from grammar alone.
- ጣዕመ ጼናሁ: construct chain ('sweetness of its scent'), in line with the glossary.
- አተወ: 'enter, go in' (published ch. 13-16), so 'withdrew' was unsupported.
- The quotation of Solomon's message runs units 3-7 (units 6-7 are still his: fem. imperative to the Queen; ካዕበ ይእቲኒ in unit 8 presupposes his message has only then ended).

## Findings refused / left as they are
- ሥልሰ ወስብዐ (unit 19): both are bare accusatives (neither a cardinal nor an ordinal in the usual form); 'thrice and seven times (?)' is the most the grammar gives. Not resolved, (?) kept. Any firmer sense (three and seven courses, the third and seventh hour, a sevenfold completion) would be invention.
- ደባትር, ምንንት, ጠባበ, መፍልስት, ትትኤመር, መሐዛት, አስተጠአጥኦ, the aromatics of unit 16, መፂፃነ, ሰመከ, መጻምአ: left with (?) as drafted; no further grammatical ground.
- ይሰደዱ (unit 4): the passive without ተ- is formally odd, but the drafter's voice-uncertainty note already says so and the sense is fixed by the parallel; no change.
- ጠቢቃተ 'strong peppers' (unit 18): 'sharp' would also do; ጠቢቅ 'strict, severe, strong' covers 'strong'; no change.
- ዝየአ (unit 3): the extra አ is unexplained; the drafter already says so.
- Splitting at ፤ (units 2-5, 9, 11...): permitted by the conventions (units end at ። ፤ ፨); unit 1 (24 words) keeps three clauses under the 45-word limit; no change.
- The choice of 'the apostles' for ሐዋርያት, 'Lord', 'Queen' etc. agrees with the published parts; no change.
